verification.anonymous_readback_method: Anonymous read-only FxTwitter API readback plus HEAD requests to expanded destination links; complements the parent Chrome submission/readback evidence.

research.scope: Bounded sample of the original Jev launch and independent Jev demo/benchmark posts. Engagement metadata retrieved from public FxTwitter read-only API; counts are a proxy snapshot, not causality evidence or an exhaustive ranking. Source-author performance claims were studied as copy, not validated or adopted.

patterns.pattern: A sharp thesis and founder point of view establish why this exists; a few concrete proof points carry the launch.
patterns.adaptation: Lead with the real one-question Hard-tier gap and open artifact release; omit unmeasured speed/cost superiority.

patterns.pattern: A vivid, immediately understandable application and visual demonstration precede methods; scope qualifiers stay concise.
patterns.adaptation: Use a real, legible benchmark graphic and a tangible feedback-to-label workflow; do not use political controversy.

patterns.pattern: One-click usable demo and informal invitation create an immediate next action.
patterns.adaptation: Give a browser workbench link, three simple steps and a build invitation; explicitly label the currently hosted2B model.

patterns.pattern: Specific reference model and candid comparative outcome make an alternative implementation credible.
patterns.adaptation: Include Jev leading by one Hard and three overall, exact public denominators and source/download links.

media.note: Published as a text thread after the native image picker kept Open disabled; optional link previews are not an attached chart.
